# Fill-in student résumé template

Use this template alongside the [worked example and editing guidance](/examples/student-resume). Replace placeholders, remove unsupported claims, and tailor the result to a real opportunity. Keep only the skills and completed work you can explain and demonstrate.

[Download the plain-text starter](/downloads/is117-resume-starter.txt), or copy the block below into your document editor. The final résumé on your portfolio should be readable and can be offered as a PDF. The starter is intentionally unfinished.

```text
YOUR NAME
NYC / Newark area | Professional email
Portfolio URL | GitHub URL | LinkedIn URL

TARGET / SUMMARY
[Current student identity, opportunity sought, and 1–2 lines of relevant
project experience. Do not present an aspirational role as employment.]

EDUCATION
New Jersey Institute of Technology, Newark, NJ
[Actual degree and major] | Expected graduation: [Month Year]
Relevant coursework: IS117 — Introduction to Website Development; [...]

SKILLS
Web: [Languages and web skills you can demonstrate]
Tools and data: [Git/GitHub, database, framework, deployment tools actually used]
Process: [Research, specifications, collaboration, QA, documentation]
AI-assisted development: [Tool and specific verified use]

SELECTED PROJECTS
[Your T-shirt business] | Individual Course Project | [Dates]
[Live URL] | [Repository URL]
- Researched [number] competitors; used [finding] to choose [audience/brand promise] and [feature/design], checked through [actual task].
- Implemented [actual working customer journey] with [actual technologies].
- Verified [specific behavior] using [actual check]; documented [limitations].

[Your group business] | Team Course Project | [Dates] | [Team size]
[Live URL] | [Repository URL]
- Helped define [business problem], [specification], and [balanced work plan].
- Personally designed/built [feature]; integrated it with [teammate's work].
- Reviewed/tested [another member's work]; recorded [finding/change/result].

[Your portfolio] | Individual Project | [Dates]
[Live URL] | [Repository URL]
- Designed [brand choices] for [audience] to communicate [style/goals].
- Published [case studies/evidence] and linked professional profiles.

ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE / INVOLVEMENT (OPTIONAL)
[Actual role] | [Organization] | [Dates]
- [Concrete responsibility or result showing a relevant transferable skill.]
```
